text: It’s difficult to express in words how much Heather added to our wedding weekend. Live painting was something my wife and I had discussed for years leading up to planning our wedding, but what she added was so much more than just that. Her organization leading up to the big day made us so confident that she’d capture exactly what we envisioned, yet she also managed to capture some incredible live footage of our wedding, interact with our family and friends, and WAKE UP AT 3AM THE NEXT MORNING with us to catch sunrise on a mountaintop on the Canadian border for a second wedding painting! I could go on for a while, but it comes down to this - Heather’s artwork and presence is one of the best choices we made for our wedding day. We will always smile when we see the painting hanging in our house, and bring us right back to our wedding night.
